name: BottomSheet
description: A widget that slides up from the bottom of the screen to display additional content. It can be persistent (always visible) or modal (temporary and dismissible).

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget displayed inside the bottom sheet.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the bottom sheet, affecting the shadow size.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the bottom sheet.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the bottom sheet's material.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the shape boundaries.

properties.name: enableDrag
properties.description: Whether the bottom sheet can be dragged down to dismiss.

properties.name: isScrollControlled
properties.description: Whether the bottom sheet can take full screen height and respond to content scrolling.
